// Binds a mesh to a skeleton for linear-blend skinning. InverseBindTransforms
// is parallel to the skeleton's bones and carries each bone's inverse
// model-space bind transform; VertexWeights is parallel to the mesh's vertices.
type SkinBinding
    implements IValue
{
    Skeleton: Skeleton;
    InverseBindTransforms: Array<AffineTransform3D>;
    VertexWeights: Array<VertexSkinWeights>;
}
